description:
Turn the current dense-matvec baseline and profile into a bounded fusion experiment before candidate samples are collected.

## Background

The portfolio admits at most one profile-justified fusion distinct from the retained fused AND-popcount route. It keeps the generic carry-save no-win out of the search. M4RI remains an external matched-operation comparison under its qualified adapter contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The portfolio names at most one exact fusion candidate, target cells, rationale from current profiles, implementation complexity budget, comparison family, and stop condition before candidate measurement.
- [hard] REQ-02: A missing profile signal is recorded as a no-candidate outcome, and the selected fused AND-popcount plus rejected generic carry-save routes remain prior evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: Candidate scope uses the canonical matvec and kernel boundary without pre-authorizing a production change.

## Notes

This is an experimental selection contract, not a production adoption decision.
title: Freeze the dense-parity candidate portfolio
